platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for the issue #123 Win32 paste-path audit on top of the issue #131 scrollback-content and issue #133 named-layout rolls, after auditing every session parser hunk. The session schema remains v1 and gains no field: this roll adds load-time pane-text rejection (InvalidPaneText) and a validation purpose so pane-text checks run on load only, letting the save path drop one hostile field instead of failing the whole save. The parser keeps the reviewed .allocate = .alloc_always ownership fix, the opaque-JSON layout placement decode, and the bounded scrollback budget. Hashes reflect checkout normalization. The durable git_commit identifies the PR base; Contracts.99-Baselines.ps1 independently pins the reviewed session-schema digest so squash-merging and deleting the PR branch cannot disable fail-closed artifact verification.
